new_scholarship.name: Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship (KDI School of Public Policy and Management)
new_scholarship.official_source: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, Korea Development Institute
new_scholarship.description: Full-tuition-waiver plus monthly stipend plus round-trip airfare award administered by KDI School, the graduate school of the Korea Development Institute, in Sejong. It is intended for working professionals in the public sector and other potential global leaders, and decisions are made by the school's Admissions Committee. There is no separate scholarship application: candidates are considered through the ordinary KDI School online admissions application.
new_scholarship.application_period: Spring and Fall admissions cycles; the Spring 2027 cycle ran to a document-review result on 2 October 2026 and a final result announcement on 19 October 2026
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals holding a Bachelor's degree or higher who satisfy one of: at least 1 year of public-sector work experience (G20 countries), at least 6 years of public-sector work experience (non-G20 countries), or a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Korea Studies regardless of nationality.
eligibility: Foreign national with a Bachelor's degree or higher
Applicants from G20 countries: at least 1 year of work experience in the public sector
Applicants from non-G20 countries: at least 6 years of work experience in the public sector
Graduates of a Korea Studies programme holding a Bachelor's (or Master's) degree in Korea Studies, regardless of nationality
coverage: Full tuition waiver for the Master's programme
benefits: Monthly stipend (amount not published on the official scholarship page)
requirements: Submit the KDI School online application with the supporting documents listed in the application guidelines
No separate scholarship application is required
application_method: Online application through the KDI School international admissions system by the published admissions deadline
new_scholarship.notes: KDI School states that all accepted international students are considered for scholarship, and that the award is limited in number and decided by the Admissions Committee on the strength of the admission process overall. No bond or service obligation is stated for this award.

programme_detail_official.description: A fully funded Master's scholarship at KDI School of Public Policy and Management, the graduate school of the Korea Development Institute in Sejong. It combines a full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend and round-trip airfare, and targets foreign nationals with public-sector experience or a Korea Studies degree. Admission and funding are linked: there is no separate scholarship application and the award is decided by the Admissions Committee.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you meet one of the three published eligibility routes (G20 public sector 1+ year, non-G20 public sector 6+ years, or a Korea Studies degree)
Have a Bachelor's degree or higher from a recognised institution
Prepare the supporting documents listed in the KDI School application guidelines for the relevant intake
Track the KDI School Notice board and Admission Calendar for the Fall 2027 guideline release
Budget for any cost the scholarship does not name, because only tuition, stipend and airfare are published
common_rejection_risks: Applying through the university route expecting a separate scholarship form - KDI School states no separate scholarship application exists
Public-sector experience below the stated 1-year (G20) or 6-year (non-G20) threshold
Applying to an intake whose guideline has not yet been published and therefore working to an outdated date
Assuming the award is open to all nationalities on identical terms; the school describes the full package as primarily intended for ODA and G20-linked applicants
estimated_uncovered_costs: Health insurance beyond any cover KDI School may bundle - not itemised on the scholarship page
Books, course materials and travel between Korea and home outside the single round-trip ticket
Visa and settlement costs in Korea, which are not listed as benefits
document_audit: Bachelor's (or higher) degree certificate and transcript
Evidence of public-sector employment length matching the chosen eligibility route
Korea Studies degree evidence if relying on that route
Passport and identity documents required by the KDI School admissions guidelines

alerts.message: KDI School published a document-review result on 2 October 2026 and a final result on 19 October 2026 for Spring 2027, so that intake can no longer be applied to. Watch the Notice board for the Fall 2027 guideline.
The official page states a monthly stipend but publishes no amount or currency figure. Do not plan a budget on an assumed figure.

submission_workflow: Read the KDI School international admissions application guideline for your intake
Register and submit the online application before the published deadline
Upload the supporting documents named in the guideline
Await document review, then interview if shortlisted
Scholarship status is confirmed with the admission result - no extra form

research_notes.dedup_check: Checked every element of the w2-29 dedup block. No KDI School entry exists in existing_titles, existing_hosts or existing_official_source_urls. The nearest entries are 'Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)' and 'GIST (Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology) Government-Sponsored Scholarship', both from different awarding bodies (NIIED and GIST respectively). KDI School's own NIIED Global Korea Scholarship for Graduate Degrees was deliberately NOT recorded because it is the GKS programme under a university-specific name. The Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship is funded and decided by KDI School itself and is a distinct scheme.

It is also an in-country award for Bhutanese students; no international Royal Government of Bhutan Scholarship call was published on the ministry site.
